Figure 1:An example of dynamic subjects across a camera revisit.While moving subjects temporarily exit the perspective view, the360∘360^{\circ}panoramic view continuously captures their motion outside the perspective viewport.
Best viewed when zoomed in.

Figure 2:Overview of the OmniPersist framework.Tokens from the dense perspective stream and the temporally sparse panoramic stream
are jointly processed by a shared, frozen Diffusion Transformer (DiT) block adapted via LoRA.
The two streams coordinate across space and time via dedicated learned feature projections
to exchange complementary context.
GeoAnch transfers spatially aligned features at synchronized timestamps, while TemComp aggregates features across neighboring timestamps for intermediate observations.
For illustration, we depict a temporal sampling interval ofs=4s=4in image-space indices.

Figure 3:Generation results on I2V across camera revisits.From top to bottom, we show a frame before the camera turns away and two revisit frames after it returns to illustrate identity preservation and continued motion.
Frames in each row share the same frame index.
